findings.summary: C0001 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (17 significant at q<0.05, top pancreatic beta cells with SMD -1.45) and CNV differences (chr20q gain, VHL locus) versus rest, supporting distinct identity.
C0002 shows distinct CNV profile (loss of CDKN2A/JAK2, lower chr20q) and mutation enrichment (KDM5C, MUC16) versus rest, supporting identity.
C0003 shows RNA pathway enrichment (heme metabolism, protein secretion) and CNV events (chr1q loss, chr17p loss) versus rest, supporting identity.
C0004 shows no significant pathway enrichment (0 at q<0.05) and no significant CNV features after FDR, with only weak mutation signals (FLG, BAP1), insufficient to confirm distinct biology.
C0005 shows strong RNA pathway enrichment (12 significant at q<0.05, myogenesis, IL6-JAK-STAT3) and CNV differences (chr1q gain, chr9q loss) versus rest, supporting identity.
C0006 shows CNV differences (chr18p/q loss, chr7q gain) and mutation enrichment (DST, MTOR) versus rest, supporting identity.
Partition shows no near-identity with stage (AMI=0.059, ARI=0.023, OMA=0.291) or grade (AMI=0.012, ARI=-0.001, OMA=0.243), indicating the clustering is not a simple echo of known labels.
